Moss's 9/30 strategic digest gives the ticket as #8841. It says Mateo Quiroga submitted it about drivers at Newark being unable to select Dock Door 14 on the check-in kiosk. You escalated it to the platform engineering queue.

Check #8841 before you send it to engineering. On Jul 1 in #strategic-pod you said you'd closed out "ticket #8841" for a different issue, the Detention Summary CSV and kiosk tablet cache problem. Either the digest has the wrong number or that number was reused. I couldn't find another number for the Door 14 ticket in anything you can see. INC-4821, in #inc-vtg-hartford, is the Hartford kiosk outage, not Door 14.
